agent_notes: The NIRF government listing confirms the exact institution name, Varanasi city, and Uttar Pradesh state.
The official BHU navigation identifies Faculty of Dental Sciences as UnitId 124 and Institute of Medical Sciences as UnitId 4.

The official catalogue returns five programme rows, including two BDS rows with inconsistent naming and eligibility formats. The detail endpoint for catalogue row 3194 returned no programme detail record, so the catalogue is treated as partial/ambiguous and the record remains manual_review.

The official Faculty homepage states that postgraduate training covers nine recognized dental specialties, but the catalogue does not enumerate those specialties as separate programme rows; no additional certificate or doctoral rows were returned.
Public GET requests used curl --insecure only after normal TLS requests produced the managed proxy self-signed certificate-chain error. No credentials or private data were sent.

Career mappings were derived from read-only queries against assets/data/career_path.db. No exact Dental Hygienist or Dental Mechanic nodes exist, so those courses use low-confidence closest-parent mapping to Paramedical & Health Sciences.
